title: Why keep the right side short?
hook: A short right spine makes two heaps easier to combine.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Heap parent/child ordering and priority comparisons.
doesNotKnow: Meld leftist heaps by recursing on right spines and restoring null-path ranks.

misconception: A meldable binary heap must be balanced by node count.
objective: Meld leftist heaps by recursing on right spines and restoring null-path ranks.

claims.text: Melding recurses along right spines. Swapping children when the left null-path rank is smaller restores the leftist invariant, making the final rank equal the length of the right spine.
